about: Squamish is a district municipality at the head of Howe Sound in British Columbia, between Vancouver and Whistler on the Sea to Sky Highway. Steep granite walls, the Stawamus Chief, and estuary wetlands frame a growing adventure-sports town that still anchors logging and industrial harbour history. About 24,000 people live in Squamish.
